source.stadiumEastCorrection: Three user-supplied Google Street View reference screenshots inspected 2026-10-10: Vanickova east pavilion from both directions and the opposite campus pavement. Capture date unavailable; references are not textures or photogrammetric geometry.
source.stadiumHeightReference: IPR Praha summer 2023 original level16 mesh: dominant east roof band Y27.1m (1142m² sampled horizontal surface), versus prior model Y23.18m. Authored height rounded to24m above the existing DEM base; not a new survey. datovy podklad © IPR Praha.
source.stadiumAccess: game closure requested 2026-10-11; not a surveyed permanent facade
source.limits: B1 three storeys are photo/document evidence, 9.6 m is interpreted. Entrance proportions and stair heights are interpreted from the named B2 photograph and ELSA description. Stadium outline/other heights retain OSM; east roof height is refined from IPR2023 mesh. Exterior pier rhythm and materials are interpreted, not surveyed. The stadium interior is closed for the pilot. B6 remains owned by its playable interior module.

coordinates: x east, y up, z south; modules subtract their origin and inverse-rotate yaw for Blender/glTF export
